subject: Private deployment demo — multi-region security reviewers & DST check
messages:
From: Ben Horton <ben.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Lin <david.lin@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request: private deployment demo + regional security reviewers

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're getting closer to a decision on a Dedicated/Private deployment and need a technical walkthrough focused on security, network boundaries, and the deployment model.

Key asks:
- 45–60 minute demo of Redwood Dedicated private deployment architecture (networking, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs).
- EU DPO and APAC security lead to attend for their respective compliance sign-off.
- Short pre-call (15 min) with security reviewers to share artifacts before the demo.

Time windows that work for our core stakeholders (Ben / Acme US HQ):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00–12:00 EDT (14:00–16:00 UTC)
- Wed Oct 7, 14:00–16:00 EDT (18:00–20:00 UTC) — pref if EU can join later in day

We know DST is still in effect in the US but EU DST ends later in October; please suggest timezone-safe options.

Attachments: acme-use-case.pdf (brief)

Thanks,
Ben Horton
Head of Platform — Acme Analytics
ben.horton@acmeanalytics.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Horton <ben.horton@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: David Lin <david.lin@cloudops-consulting.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment demo + regional security reviewers

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear note and the use case doc.

We can run the 60-minute technical demo and split it into: 15-minute security pre-brief (DPO + APAC security lead) + 45-minute demo/QA. That tends to work better for reviewers who want artifacts up front. I can also have a short runbook PDF ready.

Preliminary availability from our side (all times show local / converted):
- Tue Oct 6, 15:00–17:00 UTC (11:00–13:00 EDT) — good overlap US/EU
- Wed Oct 7, 18:00–20:00 UTC (14:00–16:00 EDT) — pushes later for EU but OK
- Thu Oct 8, 09:00–11:00 UTC (05:00–07:00 EDT) — only works if APAC prefers SGT-friendly window

Note on DST: EU clocks shift later in October (end of month), so times in early October are stable. We'll call out local offsets explicitly in the invite.

Laura, can you confirm engineering lead availability and whether we should include Jonas for KV-cache / latency sizing?

Attachments we can share ahead: SOC2-summary.pdf, redwood-dedicated-overview.pptx (will upload to the Drive link once time is locked).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Kim — engineering can cover the architecture walk and capacity sizing. Tentative for leads:
- Jonas: demo kernel selection, latency/kv-cache notes (can do Oct 6, 15:00–17:00 UTC)
- Priyom: deployment orchestration + rollout policy (best on Oct 7, 18:00–20:00 UTC if we need longer prep)

If Acme wants the EU DPO to see an artifacts packet before the pre-brief, we should surface a short network diagram and our KMS integration checklist. Happy to assemble.

Laura

Head of Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference

Hello Kimberly / Ben,

I'm Sophie, DPO (EU) for Orbital Health and supporting Acme for the EU review. I can join a 30–45 minute session to confirm data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, and audit log retention. My constraints:
- EU mornings are best (08:30–11:00 CET)
- No calls after 17:00 CET this week (travel schedule)

Would prefer a short pre-brief on artifacts (SOC2 summary + network diagram) and then attend the full demo if time allows. Please send documents in advance; I will not download large attachments but can review Drive links.

Thanks,

Data Protection Officer — Orbital Health (consulting for Acme)

- Pre-brief (30 minutes): Tue Oct 6, 15:00–15:30 UTC (16:00–16:30 BST / 11:00–11:30 EDT) — short artifact walk-through for Sophie + Acme reviewers
- Demo + QA (60 minutes): Tue Oct 6, 15:35–16:35 UTC (16:35–17:35 BST / 11:35–12:35 EDT)

Drive packet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/EXAMPLE-ACME (SOC2-summary.pdf + redwood-dedicated-overview.pptx uploaded)

Please accept or propose alternate times. If we get sign-off on Option A, I'll finalize invites and upload a short runbook.

—Priyom
